policyDetail.title: MSAS Terms & Policies
policyDetail.lastUpdated: Last Updated: 06/01/2026 · Applicable to all users of the MSAS system

terms.title: 1. Terms of Service
terms.intro: By registering and using MSAS, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to the terms below.
terms.scopeContent: MSAS provides an AI-integrated multi-channel sales data analysis platform, including data collection, BI analysis, revenue forecasting, and report exporting. The service operates under a SaaS model with two plans: Free and Pro.
terms.securityContent: Each account may only be used by one individual. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activities originating from your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access.
terms.usageContent: You are strictly prohibited from using MSAS for illegal purposes, intentionally degrading system performance, or accessing another company's data outside your authorized scope.
terms.ownershipContent: All business data you enter or sync through MSAS belongs to you. MSAS only processes this data to provide the agreed services.
terms.changeContent: We will notify you via email at least 14 days in advance of important updates. Continued use after that time implies acceptance of the new terms.
terms.terminationContent: Accounts violating these terms may be suspended. Upon termination, data is retained for an additional 30 days so you can export it before permanent deletion.

privacy.title: 2. Privacy Policy
privacy.collectContent: Account information (name, email, phone number), business data you enter or sync from sales channels, and activity logs for security and technical support.
privacy.storageContent: Data is stored on servers in Vietnam. Stored data is encrypted using AES-256; data in transit uses HTTPS/TLS secure protocols. Passwords are salted and hashed one-way; no one can view them.
privacy.accessContent: The system applies role-based access control (Owner, Manager, Staff, DataIT, Viewer) — each person only sees data suitable for their role. Business owners (Owners) can view all activity logs within the company.
privacy.nosellContent: MSAS does not sell, lease, or share your personal and business data with third parties for commercial purposes in any way.
privacy.rightsContent: You have the right to request export of all your data, edit personal information in your Profile, or request account deletion (data is permanently deleted 30 days after confirmation).
privacy.lawContent: MSAS complies with the Cybersecurity Law 2018 (24/2018/QH14), Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection, and the Electronic Transactions Law 2023 (20/2023/QH15).

refund.title: 3. Refund Policy
refund.freeDesc: The Free plan is not eligible for refund policy since no fees are charged.
refund.proDesc: Refund requests are supported within 7 days from payment if the issue originates from MSAS (continuous service disruption over 24 hours, data loss due to system failure...). No refunds if the user actively decides not to use or cancels the plan.
refund.requestText: Refund request: send an email to support@msas.vn with the subject "REFUND REQUEST – [Company Name]" along with a description of the issue.
